description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyAPI class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It provides API endpoints for managing job vacancies, including operations such as retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting vacancies. The class uses traits for services and helpers, numerous validation rules, and Swagger annotations for documentation.

classes.name: VacancyAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for handling vacancy-related operations, including CRUD functionalities, validation, and documentation annotations for the OrangeHRM recruitment module.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific vacancy by its ID, returns detailed model or throws not found exception.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all vacancies based on query parameters, with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new vacancy record with data from the request body.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Populates a Vacancy object with data from the request, validating associated entities.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving a single vacancy.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing vacancies.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the model class to use based on the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getModelClassParamRule
methods.description: Validation rule for the 'model' query parameter.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines common validation rules for vacancy creation and update.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing vacancy with new data, throwing not found if the ID doesn't exist.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validation rules for updating a vacancy.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes vacancies specified by IDs in the request body.
